0022600136.text: Toronto (2-1) hosts Orlando (1-2) in the Raptors' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Raptors 3rd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the East, on a one-game losing streak after going 2-1 in their last ten, while the Magic are 10th in the East, 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and riding a one-game winning streak. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Kawhi Leonard is day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision, while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 139-87 win in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
